Comment.MultiLanguageText: Batch sequence of the mixing station. Idle waits for Start; Fill A and Fill B open the inlet valves until the recipe levels; Mix and heat runs the agitator and heats to TempSP for MixTime; Hold waits for the filler; Drain pumps the tank empty; Done counts the batch. Every working step is interlocked with Healthy: on a fault, E-stop, Stop or Auto off its actions switch off and the step is kept. After a fault or E-stop, press Reset, then Start to continue; Reset alone does not restart the batch.
